# FindOptions interface

Sequelize's own find options, plus the parameters of a dynamic view.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface FindOptions extends FindOptionsOrigin 
```
**Extends:** FindOptionsOrigin

## Remarks

Accepted by every finder on `BaseModel`<!-- -->. The single addition is ignored unless the model was declared with `DynamicView`<!-- -->.
